title: Card Memory Game (React)
description: A fun and interactive memory game built with React, where players flip cards to find matching pairs. It dynamically tracks game state, counts moves, and resets seamlessly for new rounds — showcasing state management and conditional rendering in action.

title: React Todo App
description: A responsive and minimal to-do application built with React. It allows users to add, edit, mark as completed, and delete tasks, all while maintaining real-time UI updates through React state management and hooks.

title: Breezo
description: A simple and responsive weather application built with vanilla JavaScript. It fetches real-time weather data from an external API and displays temperature, conditions, and location details in a clean, user-friendly interface.
